method.flatness: median geometric/arithmetic frame power, relative 1e-12 floor
method.normalization: divide waveform by peak for scale invariance; never alter classifier input
method.candidate: raw logit + two quality coordinates + both raw/quality interactions + intercept
method.constraint: nonnegative raw-logit slope at all four quality-box corners
method.selection: one prespecified candidate; quality-only fit is a nuisance diagnostic

limitations: All prior test responses are consumed.
Unpublished DFADD transcript mapping; prompt-index grouping is conservative, not proof of text independence.
Intervals conditional on the reused consumed background pool.
Authentic source and generated-family channel confounding remain.
Waveform quality features can encode source/channel differences; inspect the joint VCTK panel and quality-only nuisance diagnostic.
This experiment uses no new checkpoint and does not alter the existing voice calibration.
No outside independent review; CV probabilities are not service calibrations.
